page.title: local setup
page.lead: This page lists what spectroscope needs on your machine, level by level. Level 1 is all you need to run the app. The levels after it are optional, and one route per level is enough. Mark a step with "I have this" and the ring of its level fills.

scope.text: macOS means Apple silicon. Linux means Debian 12 and 13, Ubuntu 22.04 and 24.04. Windows is not covered.

page.scriptsNote: Scripts are files to download, read and run yourself. The page runs nothing.

mac.text: The macOS commands marked "needs Homebrew" use it, and so does the speech script. If brew is not found, install Homebrew first. Its page shows the install line and explains what it does. The DMG needs no Homebrew.
source: P:README.md::is the same kit without the tap

mac.text: The commands marked "needs git" clone a repository. To install git, run brew install git, or xcode-select --install for Apple's git in the Command Line Tools.

linux.text: The commands marked "needs git" clone a repository. To install git, run sudo apt-get install git.
The Linux Docker command installs packages from Docker's own apt repository. Add that repository first, with the lines on Docker's install page for your system.

build-tools.name: cmake and a C and C++ compiler

linux.text: The whisper.cpp build lines on Linux call cmake and a C and C++ compiler. Install both from your distribution first. The whisper.cpp README shows the build.
The Linux line marked "needs Ollama" talks to a running Ollama. Install Ollama first, with its installer or the manual route on its Linux page. Step 2.2 quotes the installer.

levels.title: a local model
levels.goal: One local route answers a prompt without a cloud key. One of the four steps is enough. With the DMG, the cask, the apt package or the AppImage, the first step needs no extra install.

levels.title: speech
levels.goal: The microphone button turns speech into text on this machine, or through a hosted key.

levels.title: web search
levels.goal: The web_search tool uses a private SearXNG instance that answers JSON, or a Tavily or Brave key.

levels.title: code graph
levels.goal: Build code graph works, and the browse_page tool finds a browser.

levels.title: playbooks
levels.goal: A playbook runs from start to end on the models it names.

levels.title: developer path
levels.goal: Your project folder is the workspace, and the playbook's checks can run its tests.

steps.title: install the app
steps.enables: Installs the desktop app. The DMG, the Homebrew cask, the apt package and the AppImage bring their own Java runtime and their own llama-server.

linux.text:
curl -fsSL https://apt.spectroscope.dev/spectroscope.asc | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/spectroscope.gpg
echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/spectroscope.gpg] https://apt.spectroscope.dev stable main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/spectroscope.list
sudo apt update && sudo apt install spectroscope
linux.label: apt, Debian 12 and Ubuntu 24.04, x86_64

mac.text: Apple silicon only. There is no Intel build.

all.text: The server jar and the CLI zip need a JDK 21 or newer. Step 1.2 covers it.
The app opens its window.

steps.title: SearXNG
steps.enables: A private search engine in Docker that answers JSON. The script writes its address to ~/.spectro/.env.

mac.label: make a folder for the script and the files it writes
save install-searxng.sh into that folder, read it, then run this there

linux.label: make a folder for the script and the files it writes
save install-searxng.sh into that folder, read it, then run this there

all.text: The script needs openssl. It writes settings.yml with JSON switched on, starts one container, waits for a JSON answer, and only then writes SPECTRO_SEARXNG_URL.

install-searxng.sh runs on its own. If there is no docker-compose.yml in its folder, it writes one with the same content as the docker-compose.yml on this page. The app offers the same script in Settings, under web search.

linux.text: install-searxng.sh calls docker without sudo. On Linux, do Docker's post-installation steps from step 4.1 first, or the script stops at a permission error.

all.text: curl 'http://localhost:8888/search?q=test&format=json'
all.expect: Answers JSON. A 403 means json is missing under search.formats; web_search then reads the HTML page and still answers.

steps.title: confirm the tier
steps.enables: Shows which search route web_search takes.

all.text: spectro doctor

steps.title: Tavily or Brave
steps.enables: A hosted search key instead of SearXNG.

all.text: Create a key with Tavily or Brave and type it in Settings. The variables are TAVILY_API_KEY and BRAVE_API_KEY. With both keys, web_search uses Tavily. A saved SearXNG address comes before both.
spectro doctor
all.expect: The web search line names the Tavily or the Brave Search API.
